plays.desc_ko: 같은 시점 Zest가 사이드 라인 푸시를 계속, 억제기 포탑을 노리는 Tristana로 언급. LOS는 이를 통해 TL에 대응을 강요.
plays.desc_en: Meanwhile Zest (Tristana) keeps pushing a side lane toward the inhibitor tower, forcing TL to respond.
plays.quote: Meanwhile, Zest continues to push ... Tristana looking for an inhibitor tower.

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 바텀 쪽 시야를 장악한 상태에서 드래곤을 공략. Zest가 로켓 점프로 전진, Curse는 Quid의 레이저에 큰 피해. Curse가 Glacial Prison을 Aegis Assault로 버티고 스마이트를 노렸으나 Yeon이 30HP 상태에서 드래곤을 빼앗음. Zest는 추격 후 다시 들어가 사망(회고). 1대1.
plays.desc_en: With bot vision secured, LOS starts dragon; Zest rocket jumps in and Curse takes heavy damage from Quid's laser, tanks Glacial Prison with Aegis Assault and goes for Smite, but Yeon steals it at 30 HP. Zest chases back in and dies per the recap, ending one-for-one.
plays.quote: right now they're garnering control ... Zest here. Rocket jumping forward. ... ray coming out from Quidd. They are on

plays.desc_ko: TL이 드래곤 전투에 참여: Quid의 레이저 포킹, Glacial Prison, Morgan의 후방 진입 시도(메가 변신 지연). Yeon이 평타로 드래곤을 확보(리플레이: Jose 스마이트가 이르게 사용됐으나 Yeon 평타가 날아가던 중). 1대1 교환 후 후퇴.
plays.desc_en: TL joins the dragon fight with Quid's (Viktor) laser poke, Glacial Prison, and Morgan's (Gnar) delayed-Mega backline attempt, and Yeon (Yunara) secures it with an auto attack already in flight despite Josedeodo's early Smite. Both sides trade one-for-one and back off.
plays.quote: As Squid does land the ray onto Curse. ... THE BACK LINE, BUT HE CAN'T GO. MEGA ... Drake secured by TL BY YAN OF ALL

plays.desc_ko: TL이 공격적으로 나서 Josedeodo도 합류. Ackerman의 Bailout/Hostile Takeover가 있었으나 함께할 아군이 없었고, Kalista의 Fate's Call이 3초 남아 쓸 수 없어 TL이 상대를 잡아냄(대상은 Ackerman으로 추정). 이후 해설은 '미드에서 찾은 픽'으로 회고.
plays.desc_en: TL plays aggressively with Josedeodo (Sejuani) joining, and with Ackerman's Bailout and Hostile Takeover unsupported and Kalista's Fate's Call still 3 seconds on cooldown, TL picks off a target, likely Ackerman; the casters later call it the pick found in mid.
plays.quote: chasing onto a Jose coming in as well. ... call wasn't quite available and they ... catch him out. What a timing from Team

plays.desc_ko: 인원 우위 상태에서 TL이 바론을 침. LOS는 진입 수단이 부족해 싸우지 않음. 이후 '바론이 TL에 기회를 줬다'는 회고.
plays.desc_en: TL takes Baron with a numbers advantage while LOS lacks the engage to fight it, later recalled as the Baron that opened a window for TL.
plays.quote: Liquid. And now with a member down, are ... going to start hitting. It's a 4v5 and ... They're not going to play it. Dudu is

plays.desc_ko: 바론 버프를 가진 TL이 전진하며 포탑에 피해를 넣고, Quid가 레이저 포킹과 궁극기를 Feisty에게 사용(드래곤을 앞두고 빠른 궁 사용).
plays.desc_en: With Baron, TL pushes and damages towers as Quid (Viktor) pokes with lasers and uses his ultimate on Feisty, an early ult ahead of dragon.
plays.quote: ones with the control now pushing up ... with this baron starting to get damage ... used onto Feisty eats an arcane raid

plays.desc_ko: Dudu가 Glacial Prison에 붙잡혔지만 TL의 후속타가 없음. Arcane Storm도 떨어지고 LOS가 피해를 버팀.
plays.desc_en: Duduhh (Kalista) is caught by Glacial Prison, but TL has no follow-up, and LOS absorbs the damage even as Chaos Storm lands.
plays.quote: Doodoo caught out with the glacial ... prison. No real followup from Team

plays.desc_ko: Feisty의 Weaver's Wall, Curse의 Grand Starfall로 후방 진입, Ackerman Hostile Takeover. Yeon이 사망하고 LOS가 강가에서 TL을 쓸어 4대0. Morgan만 생존. 회고: Curse의 점멸 스턴→Hostile Takeover로 Yeon이 순삭, CoreJJ는 Taliyah 벽에 갇혀 Wild Growth를 못 줌, Zest가 리셋으로 정리.
plays.desc_en: Feisty's Weaver's Wall, Curse's Grand Starfall backline dive and Ackerman's Hostile Takeover kill Yeon as LOS sweeps TL 4-0 in the river, leaving only Morgan alive. The recap: Curse's Flash-stun into Hostile Takeover deletes Yeon, CoreJJ is walled off from giving Wild Growth, and Zest cleans up with resets.
plays.quote: Weaver's wall from Fisty Grand Star ... LOS JUST WIPE AWAY TEAM IN THE RIVER. ... FOUR FOR NONE.

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 드래곤을 확보하지 못한 사이 Josedeodo가 스마이트로 드래곤을 확보해 게임을 연장. 이후 회고에서 TL이 궁극기를 Dudu 포킹에 써서 드래곤을 얻었다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: With LOS unable to finish dragon, Josedeodo (Sejuani) smites it to extend the game; the recap notes TL earned it by using ultimates to poke Duduhh.
plays.quote: DRAGON EITHER. JOSE WAS ABLE TO SMITE IT ... So dragon secured by Team Liquid, the ... sorry use the ultimates for poke onto

plays.desc_ko: 4대0 이후 LOS가 게임을 끝내려 미드 억제기 포탑을 공략했으나 Morgan에게 밀려나고 후퇴. Zest가 없었던 점이 언급됨.
plays.desc_en: After the 4-0, LOS hits the mid inhibitor tower to close out but is pushed back by Morgan (Gnar) and retreats, with Zest's absence noted.
plays.quote: done it. They're going to look to end ... forced away los on the inhibitor tower ... They're backing up. The game's not over

plays.desc_ko: 혼자 살아남은 Morgan이 시간을 끌며 미드 억제기 포탑에서 LOS를 밀어냄. 해설 'Morgan saves it'.
plays.desc_en: Lone survivor Morgan (Gnar) stalls and drives LOS off the mid inhibitor tower: 'Morgan saves it.'
plays.quote: Morgan trying to stall the game. ... Morgan saves it. ... been over, but Morgan saved that game.

plays.desc_ko: Grand Starfall 각을 보며 LOS가 Yeon을 고립시키려 함. Yeon은 정화(Cleanse)로 해제, Ackerman 핸드셰이크 빗나감. Dudu가 점멸로 들어와 처치를 노렸으나 Dudu가 사망. 'LOS가 Yan에게 진입했지만 이번엔 통하지 않았다.' 4대5, TL도 체력이 낮음.
plays.desc_en: Eyeing Grand Starfall, LOS tries to isolate Yeon (Yunara), who Cleanses out as Ackerman's Handshake misses, and Duduhh (Kalista) flashes in for the kill but dies. 'LOS went onto Yan, but not this time,' leaving it 4v5 with TL also low.
plays.quote: Positioning for a grand star for Jose ... Yon is split. Y is split. Cleanses away. ... DOESN'T LAND IT. DUDU FLASHING FORWARD.

plays.desc_ko: LOS 측이 CoreJJ를 잡아 큰 피해를 주고 Lulu의 점멸을 빼냄. 이어 바론 시작 언급.
plays.desc_en: LOS catches CoreJJ (Lulu), dealing heavy damage and forcing out his Flash, before Baron is mentioned as starting.
plays.quote: CATCHES CJ. THAT'S A LOT OF DAMAGE AND ... THE FLASH out of the Lulu.

plays.desc_ko: Morgan이 TP로 합류하고 Yeon과 Josedeodo가 바론을 빠르게 녹임. Feisty가 측면에서 피해를 넣으려 했으나 LOS가 진입하지 못해 TL이 바론 확보.
plays.desc_en: Morgan (Gnar) teleports in as Yeon (Yunara) and Josedeodo (Sejuani) melt Baron; Feisty tries to deal damage from the flank but LOS can't engage and TL secures it.
plays.quote: now tping in. 10,000 health on that ... Baron, but Yan and Jose Deodto are ... at bay and secure the Baron.

plays.desc_ko: TL이 바론을 치는 사이 Zest가 드래곤을 치고, Weaver's Wall이 TL을 둘로 갈라 LOS가 인페르널 영혼 확보. 해설은 바론과 영혼의 교환으로 정리.
plays.desc_en: While TL hits Baron, Zest (Tristana) takes dragon and Weaver's Wall splits TL in two as LOS claims Infernal Soul, a Baron-for-soul trade.
plays.quote: Zest is hitting already. ... GET THERE. THE WEAVER'S WOOL SPLITS THEM ... IN TWO AND THAT IS SO CLOSE. The trade

plays.desc_ko: LOS가 Yeon을 노렸으나 Yeon이 오히려 Feisty를 쫓아냄. Feisty는 진입에 점멸을 사용한 상태.
plays.desc_en: LOS goes for Yeon (Yunara), but he chases Feisty (Taliyah) off instead, with Feisty having used Flash to engage.
plays.quote: is well. They'll look for Yan who CAN ... JUST CHASE FEISTY OUT. FEISTY HAS THE

plays.desc_ko: Yeon이 재진입, Josedeodo도 합류. 핸드셰이크는 빗나감, Feisty는 무언가를 감지하고 후퇴. Quid가 추격, Zest는 로켓 점프로 이탈, Quid의 Gravity Field는 실패하고 Curse는 점멸로 빠짐. 결과적으로 TL이 미드에서 3v5 푸시 기회를 얻음. 해설: Yeon의 피해가 LOS를 주저하게 만듦.
plays.desc_en: Yeon (Yunara) re-engages with Josedeodo joining; Handshake misses and Feisty senses danger and backs off, Quid chases, Zest rocket jumps out, Quid's Gravity Field fails and Curse flashes away. TL gets a 3v5 mid push window, as Yeon's damage makes LOS hesitate.
plays.quote: Jan looking for ... the re-engage here. Jose going in as ... something out. Backs away. The chase in

plays.desc_ko: Feisty가 미드 웨이브를 놓친 틈에 TL이 미드 압박을 이어 억제기를 파괴.
plays.desc_en: With Feisty missing the mid wave, TL keeps up mid pressure and destroys the inhibitor.
plays.quote: aggressive. Big mistake there by Feisty ... the mid lane and Team Liquid take down ... an inhibitor.

plays.desc_ko: Quid가 바텀 라인에서 약 2.5 웨이브의 느린 푸시(slow push)를 세팅. TL은 엘더 쪽으로 이동.
plays.desc_en: Quid (Viktor) sets up a slow push of about 2.5 waves in bot as TL moves toward Elder.
plays.quote: I mean, Quid's in bot lane taking the ... It is a nice slow push that Quid has set ... important right now. Team Liquid shading

plays.desc_ko: 엘더·바론 직전 Morgan이 Curse를 추격해 Aegis Assault를 빼냄. Feisty는 Weaver's Wall 각을 계속 탐색.
plays.desc_en: Right before Elder and Baron, Morgan (Gnar) chases Curse (Pantheon) to draw out Aegis Assault while Feisty keeps searching for a Weaver's Wall angle.
plays.quote: Morgan chasing onto Curse. Gets the ... Aegis assault out. Feisty still looking

plays.desc_ko: Dudu가 Yeon에게 달려들고 Yeon은 탈진을 정화. Dudu는 체력이 낮아짐. Josedeodo가 너무 깊이 들어가 사망, Hostile Takeover는 TL이 대시로 피함. Curse가 쫓기며 Morgan이 Curse를 밀쳐냈지만 Morgan도 체력이 낮아지고, Quid는 Seismic Shove를 맞고 Wild Growth로도 살지 못함. Zest가 점멸로 Yeon을 쫓고, CoreJJ는 점멸했지만 Zest에게 사망. Yeon은 생존.
plays.desc_en: Duduhh dives Yeon, who cleanses Exhaust and leaves Duduhh low; Josedeodo dies too deep and TL dashes away from Hostile Takeover. Morgan shoves off Curse but drops low, Quid is hit by Seismic Shove and dies despite Wild Growth, and Zest flashes after Yeon and kills CoreJJ despite his Flash, while Yeon survives.
plays.quote: You're right. Dudu chases onto Yan. ... AWAY FROM JOSE DIE. JAN still alive ... ALIVE AS LOS HAVE FOUND TWO. Will TL

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 LOS가 엘더 드래곤 확보.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, LOS secures Elder Dragon.
plays.quote: HIS HANDS AS THE ELDER SECURED FOR LOS.

plays.desc_ko: 엘더 이후 LOS가 미드로 밀고 들어가 경기 종료. 바텀 웨이브의 중요성 언급. 'Morgan, 이번엔 지킬 게임이 남지 않았다.'
plays.desc_en: After Elder, LOS pushes through mid to end the game, with the bot wave's importance noted: 'Morgan, this time there's no game left to save.'
plays.quote: ZEST IS HUNTING. CB LOL IS HUNGRY. AND ... FOR THE CB LOL AS THEY push down mid. ... THIS TIME THERE IS NO GAME left to save.
